Tom Cruise's 'Days of Thunder' Sequel Casts Anne Hathaway; Actor Randy Quaid Criticizes

Tom Cruise is set to star in a sequel to his 1990 film 'Days of Thunder,' with the movie slated for a June 2028 release. Anne Hathaway has been cast in the sequel. Actor Randy Quaid has publicly criticized Hathaway's casting, calling it a 'horrible choice' and referencing her pregnancy. Hathaway has reportedly stated she will 'have a baby then make this movie.'
